rationale: The opening question concerns causal explanation, while the measured count concerns feature mentions; the final accuracy claim and any implied map-only effect need alignment with that distinction.

The approved start date, new stop locations, and accessibility contact for a family notice.

The board has approved the closure or set an implementation date.
